program_name: African and African American Studies, BA

programme_facts.value: International students who wish to pursue their studies at ASU must obtain an F-1 or J-1 visa.

metadata.chunk_title: Activate your ASURITE User ID + Request your I-20 and apply for your visa + Give your parents or family access to your records and account + Pay your enrollment deposit (on-campus students only) + Complete the math placement test

programme_facts.value: International students are required to obtain a U.S. visa, which includes submitting a graduate financial guarantee.

metadata.chunk_title: ASU has a rich and vibrant education environment due in large part to our diverse international student community.

programme_facts.value: While not required for admission, submitting required visa forms when you apply expedites the process of obtaining a visa if admission is granted.

metadata.chunk_title: ASU has a rich and vibrant education environment due in large part to our diverse international student community.

programme_facts.value: Once you have received your I-20, be sure to pay your I-901 fee.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: It is extremely important that you submit the documents required for the issuance of your I-20.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Upload the required documents through My ASU. The upload tool on My ASU only allows the upload of each document type once.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: If you upload financial documents that do not cover the full funding needed as shown on the financial guarantee, you will be asked to submit additional documentation to demonstrate the full funding, which will delay the issuance of your I-20.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Once ASU has received all documents required to issue an I-20 and has verified that they are complete, you will receive an email with a link to download your I-20 from the Document Portal in My ASU.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Once received, you should print the I-20 and sign the document. You will not receive a physical I-20 via mail.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: The email regarding your I-20 will be sent to your non-ASU personal email address. Be sure to check it often, including junk and spam folders.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: If you are unable to submit the documentation needed to receive an I-20 from ASU or are unable to obtain your F1 visa in time to arrive by the start of the semester of your admission, contact [international admissions email](mailto:[email protected]).

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: To receive your I-20, you must submit financial guarantee form, financial document, foreign SEVIS address, copy of passport, SEVIS transfer form if applicable.
Processing times for I-20 forms can vary based on when documents were submitted and your admission status.
We look forward to your arrival and have been hard at work making plans to welcome our new international students to campus.
Once the fee has been paid do not delay in contacting your consulate to obtain a visa appointment. Some consulates may have long wait times.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: View the I-20 Frequently Asked Questions webpage for more information.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Be sure to check wait times for your local embassy or consulate, as some areas may be experiencing wait times longer than 30 days.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: You can now apply for your visa up to 365 days before the start date listed on your I-20.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder
